# Data Structures: Trees and Graphs
Covers hierarchical (tree) and network (graph) data structures with their properties, operations, and key algorithms.
## Binary Trees
- Height, balance, and completeness properties - BST operations: search, insert, delete — all O(log n) average [source](hypatia://cite?file=data-structures.pdf&page=1) - Traversals: in-order, pre-order, post-order, level-order
## Graphs
- Types: directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted, cyclic/acyclic - Representations: adjacency matrix vs adjacency list [source](hypatia://cite?file=data-structures.pdf&page=2) - Algorithms: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's, Bellman-Ford, MST
See also: [[binary-search-tree]], [[graph-algorithms]]

# Binary Search Tree
A binary tree where left child < parent < right child [source](hypatia://cite?file=data-structures.pdf&page=1).
## Complexity
| Operation | Average | Worst | |-----------|---------|-------| | Search | O(log n) | O(n) | | Insert | O(log n) | O(n) | | Delete | O(log n) | O(n) |
## Traversals
- **In-order**: Produces sorted output - **Pre-order**: Useful for tree copying - **Post-order**: Useful for deletion - **Level-order**: BFS using a queue
See also: [[graph-algorithms]], [[data-structures-trees-graphs]]

# Graph Algorithms
Key algorithms for traversing and analyzing graphs [source](hypatia://cite?file=data-structures.pdf&page=2).
## Traversal
- **BFS**: Shortest path in unweighted graphs, O(V + E) - **DFS**: Topological sort, cycle detection, O(V + E)
## Shortest Path
- **Dijkstra's**: Weighted graphs, non-negative weights, O((V + E) log V) - **Bellman-Ford**: Handles negative weights, O(V * E)
## Minimum Spanning Tree
- **Kruskal's**: Sort edges, union-find - **Prim's**: Grow tree from vertex
See also: [[binary-search-tree]], [[data-structures-trees-graphs]]
